He is often depicted as having an elephant head and multiple arms, and he is known to remove obstacles and bring good fortune.

vedic_reference.note: Gangesh is a name of Lord Shiva who is also known as 'Mahadev', 'Nataraja' and 'Lord of the Universe'. The river Ganges is considered sacred in Hinduism and is believed to cleanse sins and bestow salvation. The combination of these two elements, Ganga and Ish, symbolizes the divine grace and power of Lord Shiva over the river.
